scene.description: Chaotic urban street in a sprawling metropolis, captured in dynamic slow-motion stride towards the viewer.
scene.environment: Crumbling concrete buildings, overturned vehicles, and billowing smoke from distant explosions; faint GTA-style wanted stars and neon signs in the haze.
scene.mood: Silent confidence and calculated menace; high-octane action with a gritty, adrenaline-fueled 'GTA' vibe.

aesthetic.style: Anime crossover with cel-shaded GTA Vice City game art; chibi-proportioned characters in hyper-detailed urban chaos.
aesthetic.look: Vibrant saturated colors with sharp outlines; dynamic motion blur; retro video game filter with subtle pixel edges and explosive particle effects.

lighting.description: Dramatic backlighting from roaring orange fireballs and muzzle flashes; harsh sunlight filtering through smoke for rim light on shoulders; volumetric god rays piercing the dust.

demographics.build: Broad-shouldered and athletic, ex-soldier physique with a mercenary's rugged poise.

appearance.hair: Spiky blonde locks with windswept volume; subtle whisker-like scars on cheeks for signature Naruto flair.
appearance.skin: Tanned and weathered from battles, with a determined, unyielding expression.

pose.action: Striding confidently towards the camera, away from the inferno; left hand gripping a slung AK-47 rifle, right hand clutching a weathered duffel bag; subtle smirk of silent assurance.
pose.framing: Full-body low-angle shot; heroic three-quarter view emphasizing broad shoulders and purposeful gait.

wardrobe.top: Faded orange tracksuit jacket with reinforced tactical patches and rolled sleeves.
wardrobe.bottom: Cargo pants tucked into combat boots, scuffed from urban skirmishes.

accessories.weapon: Soviet-era assault rifle slung over shoulder; bulging duffel bag with visible ammo clips.

props_in_scene.background: Massive fireball eruptions behind, scattering debris and panicked civilians; flickering GTA loading screen elements like health bars or mission icons subtly integrated.
props_in_scene.chaos: Shattered glass storefronts and sparking power lines; distant helicopter spotlight cutting through the smoke.

camera_technical.requirements: Maintain anime proportions with GTA exaggeration; ensure whisker marks and hair spikes are prominent; no facial distortions in motion blur.
camera_technical.capture: Cinematic game render ~35mm equiv lens, f/2.8 depth, ISO 400, 1/60s for slow-mo trails, WB 5500K with warm explosion tints.
camera_technical.composition: Rule-of-thirds with subject dominating foreground; leading lines from explosion trails drawing eye to figure; keep bag and weapon textures detailed.
camera_technical.retouching: Enhance cel-shading edges; preserve fabric tears and smoke wisps; boost color pop on orange jacket without oversaturation.
camera_technical.avoid: Realistic photo filters, limp poses, cluttered foregrounds, inconsistent art styles, text overlays.
